notes.md: - **World Computer Literacy Day (2 December):** started by the Indian computer education company **NIIT** in **2001** to mark its 20th anniversary; it spreads computer skills, especially among women and children.

- **National Cyber Security Strategy 2020 (draft):** formulated by the **Office of the National Cyber Security Coordinator** in the **National Security Council Secretariat (NSCS)**; public comments were invited till 31 December 2019.

new.s: How many digits does the ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) number have?
new.x: ABHA is a 14-digit health ID, while Aadhaar is a 12-digit number.
new.angle: U0715 notes gap: ABHA -> 14 digits

new.s: About how many Aadhaar numbers had been generated by 31 July 2025?
new.x: About 142 crore Aadhaar numbers had been generated by 31 July 2025 (about 133.65 crore live).
new.angle: U0715 notes gap: Aadhaar numbers generated -> 142 crore

new.s: What is the main aim of the Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC), launched in 2022?
o: An open e-commerce network that breaks platform monopolies
A UPI app for small payments without a PIN
new.x: ONDC (2022) is an open e-commerce network meant to break the monopoly of big platforms; consent-based data sharing is the Account Aggregator.
new.angle: U0715 notes gap: ONDC -> purpose

new.s: Roughly what share of India's GDP does the digital economy account for?
new.x: India's digital economy is about 12-14% of GDP.
new.angle: U0715 notes gap: digital economy -> 12-14% of GDP

new.s: How many accounts had been opened under the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) by August 2026?
new.x: PMJDY had 58.77 crore accounts by August 2026, more than half of them held by women.
new.angle: U0715 notes gap: PMJDY accounts -> 58.77 crore

new.s: About how much money had been transferred through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) by May 2025?
new.x: About Rs 44 lakh crore had been transferred through DBT by May 2025; Rs 3.48 lakh crore is the savings claimed.
new.angle: U0715 notes gap: DBT transfers -> Rs 44 lakh crore

new.s: What incentive was offered under the PLI scheme for mobile manufacturing notified on 1 April 2020?
new.x: The PLI scheme for mobiles, notified on 1 April 2020, gives a 4-6% incentive.
new.angle: U0716 notes gap: PLI mobiles -> 4-6% incentive

new.s: Where do electronics stand among India's export items?
new.x: Electronics is India's third-largest export, and India is the second-largest mobile maker.
new.angle: U0716 notes gap: electronics -> 3rd-largest export

new.s: How many village panchayats of Andhra Pradesh are covered by the Memorandum of Cooperation signed in February 2026 under the Amended BharatNet Programme?
new.x: The AP MoC of 22 February 2026 with the Digital Bharat Nidhi Administrator covers 13,426 village panchayats.
new.angle: U0716 notes gap: AP BharatNet MoC -> 13,426 panchayats

new.s: What does the AP Police Seva app provide?
o: Citizen services of AP Police such as complaints and NOCs
Building plan approval and vacant land tax
new.x: AP Police Seva gives AP Police citizen services such as complaints and NOCs; the SOS app was Disha.
new.angle: U0717 #3 notes gap: AP Police Seva -> purpose

new.s: Which app of Andhra Pradesh offers police citizen services such as filing complaints and getting NOCs?
new.x: AP Police Seva is the AP Police citizen-services app; Pura Seva is municipal and Mana Mitra is WhatsApp governance.

new.s: What is the outlay of e-Pragati, the AP State Enterprise Architecture?
new.x: e-Pragati has an outlay of Rs 2,358 crore for 72 projects in 14 packages; about Rs 1,528 crore is the State's share.
new.angle: U0717 #7 notes gap: e-Pragati outlay -> Rs 2,358 crore

new.s: How many Chief Data Officers does Andhra Pradesh have under its real-time governance set-up?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh has 59 Chief Data Officers.
new.angle: U0717 #8 notes gap: AP Chief Data Officers -> 59

new.s: How much revenue did temples earn through bookings on Mana Mitra, AP's WhatsApp governance service?
new.x: Temples earned Rs 22.26 crore from 21 temples through Mana Mitra, with Srikalahasti earning the most.
new.angle: U0717 notes gap: Mana Mitra temple revenue -> Rs 22.26 crore

new.s: Since which year has the Real Time Governance Society (RTGS) of Andhra Pradesh been revived as an AI-driven governance platform?
new.x: RTGS was formed in 2017 and revived from 2024 as an AI-driven governance platform.
new.angle: U0717 #8 notes gap: RTGS revived -> 2024, AI-driven

new.s: What is the investment in Google's 1-GW AI data centre at Visakhapatnam?
new.x: Google's 1-GW AI data centre at Visakhapatnam involves Rs 1.35 lakh crore; its foundation was laid in April 2026.

new.s: What is AP Online?
o: A web portal for G2C services
A state-wide area network linking mandals
new.x: AP Online is a web portal for Government-to-Citizen services; CARD handles registration and APSWAN is the network.

new.s: Which company provides AP FiberNet's triple-play services?

new.s:
Consider the following statements about doxxing:
1. It has a universal legal definition.
2. It is prosecuted under stalking, harassment and cyber-crime laws.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Doxxing has no universal legal definition, so it is prosecuted under stalking, harassment and cyber-crime laws.
new.angle: U0718 #4 notes gap: doxxing -> legal remedy

new.s: Fake news about whom does the PIB Fact Check Unit, set up in November 2019, debunk?
o: Government of India, its ministries and PSUs
new.x: The PIB Fact Check Unit debunks fake news about the Government of India, its ministries and PSUs.
new.angle: U0718 #2 notes gap: PIB FCU -> scope

new.s: Which organisation started World Computer Literacy Day in 2001?
new.x: The Indian computer education company NIIT started World Computer Literacy Day (2 December) in 2001 to mark its 20th anniversary.
new.angle: U0718 #3 web: Computer Literacy Day -> NIIT, 2001

new.s: What type of malware is Zeus?
new.x: Zeus is a Trojan: it is disguised as genuine software, does not self-replicate and opens a backdoor.
new.angle: U0719 #2 notes gap: Zeus -> Trojan

new.s: Fireball is an example of which type of malware?
new.x: Fireball is adware, which shows unwanted ads and comes bundled with free or pirated software.
new.angle: U0719 #1 notes gap: Fireball -> adware

new.s: Who created Creeper (1971), the first self-copying program?
new.x: Creeper was written by Bob Thomas of BBN on ARPANET and was removed by Reaper.
new.angle: U0719 #2 notes gap: Creeper -> Bob Thomas

new.s: Who wrote Elk Cloner (1982), the first virus found 'in the wild'?
new.x: Elk Cloner, which infected Apple II computers, was written by Rich Skrenta.
new.angle: U0719 #2 notes gap: Elk Cloner -> Rich Skrenta

new.s: Who created Brain (1986), the first IBM-PC boot-sector virus?
new.x: Brain was created by the Alvi brothers of Lahore, Pakistan.
new.angle: U0719 #2 notes gap: Brain -> Alvi brothers

new.s: Which firm found the StrandHogg Android vulnerability in 2019?
new.x: StrandHogg, in which malware poses as genuine apps, was found by the Norwegian firm Promon.
new.angle: U0719 #2 notes gap: StrandHogg -> Promon, Norway

new.s: Which group leaked the EternalBlue exploit in 2017?
new.x: EternalBlue was developed by the US NSA and leaked by the Shadow Brokers in 2017.
new.angle: U0719 #2 notes gap: EternalBlue -> leaked by Shadow Brokers

new.s: Which country was hit by the NotPetya attack of 2017?
new.x: NotPetya (2017), a ransomware that encrypts the master boot record, hit Ukraine.
new.angle: U0719 #2 notes gap: NotPetya -> Ukraine

new.s: What is SQL injection?
o: Sending the same e-mail repeatedly to one address
Entering malicious database code through a website's input fields
Phishing carried out by voice calls
Secretly intercepting communication between two parties
new.x: SQL injection sends malicious database code through a website's input fields.
new.angle: U0719 #3 notes gap: SQL injection -> meaning

new.s: Which attack enters malicious database code through the input fields of a website?
new.x: SQL injection uses website input fields to send malicious database code.
new.angle: U0719 #15 notes gap: input-field attack -> SQL injection

new.s: According to NCRB 2023, about what share of cyber crime cases were fraud cases?
new.x: NCRB 2023 recorded 86,420 cyber crime cases, about 69% of them fraud; 31.2% was the rise over 2022.
new.angle: U0719 #18 notes gap: NCRB 2023 -> fraud ~69%

new.s: Which of the following is an example of a hashing algorithm?
new.x: SHA-256 is a hash function giving a one-way, fixed-length digest; AES and Blowfish are symmetric and RSA is asymmetric.
new.angle: U0719 #6 notes gap: hashing -> SHA-256

new.s: What did the Supreme Court decide about Section 69A of the IT Act in Shreya Singhal v. Union of India (2015)?
o: It was referred to a larger bench
It was declared void for vagueness
new.x: In Shreya Singhal the Court struck down Section 66A, upheld Section 69A (blocking) and read down Section 79.
new.angle: U0720 #5 notes gap: Shreya Singhal -> 69A upheld

new.s: What is the main role of the National Technical Research Organisation (NTRO)?
new.x: NTRO is the technical intelligence agency; NCIIPC works under it. Incident response is CERT-In's job.
new.angle: U0720 #13 notes gap: NTRO -> technical intelligence

new.s: When did India sign the UN Convention against Cybercrime?
new.x: The UN Cybercrime Convention was adopted on 24 December 2024, opened for signature at Hanoi in October 2025, and signed by India in September 2026.
new.angle: U0720 #16 notes gap: India signs UN cybercrime convention -> Sept 2026

new.s: Which body formulated the draft National Cyber Security Strategy 2020?
new.x: The draft National Cyber Security Strategy 2020 was formulated by the Office of the National Cyber Security Coordinator in the National Security Council Secretariat.
